## Problem Statement
What laboratory workflow or engineering limitation does this solve?

## Proposed Solution
Describe the desired lab-agnostic capability, tool schema, or workflow improvement.

## Constraints Checklist
- [ ] Remains zero-API-cost (no LLM API keys or outbound AI calls)
- [ ] Remains lab-agnostic (no single-course or single-SWF hardcoding)
- [ ] Preserves strict provenance separation (`simulator_captured`, `bench_manual`, `model_computed`)

## Additional Context
Add examples, physics use cases, or references to existing docs/tools.
